card.name: Subject classification code titles
card.fires_on: Words inside the titles of academic subject classification entries, such as JEL economics codes and Australian FoR or SEO codes. It fires on the words of the category name after a code number, where a general or unspecified category label may come next.

modes.label: JEL economics codes
modes.description: Words inside JEL category titles in a repository subject list, such as Economic Development or Technological Change.
modes.example: > O11 - Macroeconomic Analyses of Economic Development O - Economic Development, Technological Change, and Growth > O3 - Techn<<ological>> Change; Research and Development; Intellectual Property

modes.label: FoR and SEO research codes
modes.description: Words in Australian research classification titles with percentages, such as Curriculum and Pedagogy or Expanding Knowledge in Education.

card.writes: It pushes toward catch-all category labels such as unspecified and miscellaneous, as in the "not elsewhere classified" entries.
card.plain: It marks the middle of subject-category titles in classification lists, where a catch-all label like "other" or "unspecified" may follow.
